canada.title: A day before US-brokered talks, Russia and Ukraine batter each other with long-range strikes
canada.summary: KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — Russia battered Ukraine’s power grid again and Ukrainian forces hit another of Russia’s biggest oil refineries, officials said Monday, hours before delegations from Moscow and Kyiv were due to meet for new U.S.-brokered talks on how to end the fighting.

canada.title: OSAP pause may force dental college to close, school says
